notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea is now released!
🎉🎉🎉

After 4 months of solo development, CWES is now out to the world. What started as a few scribblings in my sketchbook in August is now a fully playable story about a group of 4 people navigating the Victorian era and the aftermath of an unsolved vampire attack from a decade prior.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/b33952d5cc3f5459acabb77aeb0c9899d758ec14.jpg

Treat this more as a tale that you're coming along for the ride for rather than an interactive story, as this is a kinetic novel with no choices. Sit back for 2 hours and follow Cecil and Nemo along their travels.

I hope you'll enjoy the journey.

— Arimia
